title: Rendered type and spacing mostly bypass the --hpo-text / --hpo-space scales
claim: Across 50 states x 3 viewports x 2 themes x 3 languages the card renders 17 distinct font sizes outside its 4-step type scale {12, 13, 15, 18 px} (9.28 to 19.6 px; e.g. every what-if button at 14 px, legend chips at 16 px, dialog tabs at 16.66 px, the title at 19.6 px) and 45 distinct non-zero padding/margin/gap values outside its 5-step space scale {4, 8, 12, 16, 24 px}.
mechanism: The token layer (CARD_SCALE_TOKENS) is read by a minority of rules: of 83 font-size declarations most are em multipliers (0.78em, 0.82em, 0.85em, 0.9em, 1.1em, 1.25em, 1.4em ...) and literal px, and paddings/gaps are em or literal px (3px 10px, 6px 8px, 0.45em 0.7em ...), so the computed sizes scatter between and beyond the steps.

evidence.machine: box B10 (4 vCPU, Linux, Chromium 1243 via playwright 1.63.0, Node 22)
evidence.contention_note: ran beside the seat's own grid runs; a count, contention-immune
evidence.unit: count of distinct computed font-sizes of visible HTML text off {12,13,15,18} px (full grid: 17)

instrumented_symbol: custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/www/heatpump-optimizer-card.js:cardStyleBlock (font-size, padding, margin, gap declarations) as Chromium computes them; CARD_SCALE_TOKENS

perturbation.change: --perturb=type_tokens: every font-size of 0.82em/0.85em (bare or inside max(12px, ...)) reads var(--hpo-text-sm, 13px); space_snap snaps literal 2/3/6/10 px paddings/margins/gaps (offscale_spacing 40 -> 39)

metric_definition: distinct computed font-size values (2 dp) of visible HTML elements with own text, across the cells, not in {12,13,15,18} px
phenomenon_property: The card's rendered type sizes and spacing are drawn from its declared scales (--hpo-text-*, --hpo-space-*), so a state introduces no size the scale does not name.

null_control.value: the 4 on-scale sizes and 5 on-scale spacings are rendered too
null_control.note: tiles, headline values, labels and pills that read the tokens land exactly on the scale (12/13/15/18 px, 8/12 px), so the instrument does not read the scale itself as off

proposed_fix_scope: Map the em/px sizes and spacings in cardStyleBlock onto the existing tokens (adding a step only where a size is deliberate), one rule family per change, re-running the P9 grid.
criteria_statement: D4.M3 'consistency of typography, spacing and colour tokens across card states' under 'look professional'
